name: @tpmjs/tools-postgres
description: PostgreSQL tools for AI agents. Schema introspection, query execution, data operations, and database monitoring via direct pg connection.

tools.name: testConnection
tools.description: Test connectivity. Returns server version, current database, user, and latency.

tools.name: getDatabaseInfo
tools.description: Database metadata: size, encoding, collation, active connections.

tools.name: listSchemas
tools.description: List schemas, filtering pg_* and information_schema by default.

tools.name: listTables
tools.description: Tables in a schema with row count estimates, size, and description.

tools.name: describeTable
tools.description: Full table structure: columns, PK, FKs, indexes, constraints, checks.

tools.name: listColumns
tools.description: Columns with types, nullability, defaults, and descriptions.

tools.name: listIndexes
tools.description: Indexes: name, columns, unique, type, size, usage stats.

tools.name: listConstraints
tools.description: PKs, FKs, unique, check, exclusion constraints.

tools.name: listViews
tools.description: Views and materialized views with definitions.

tools.name: listFunctions
tools.description: User-defined functions with signatures and return types.

tools.name: listEnums
tools.description: Enum types with their values.

tools.name: executeQuery
tools.description: Execute SQL with parameterized queries. Row limit (default 100), 30s timeout.

tools.name: explainQuery
tools.description: EXPLAIN ANALYZE with costs, actual times, buffers.

tools.name: insertRows
tools.description: Insert rows into a table. Parameterized values.

tools.name: updateRows
tools.description: Update rows with WHERE clause (required). Returns affected count.

tools.name: deleteRows
tools.description: Delete rows with WHERE clause (required). Returns affected count.

tools.name: getTableStats
tools.description: Live/dead tuples, seq/index scans, last vacuum/analyze.

tools.name: getTableSize
tools.description: Size breakdown: table, index, toast, total.

tools.name: listActiveQueries
tools.description: Running queries: PID, duration, state, query text.

tools.name: listLocks
tools.description: Current locks: relation, mode, granted, blocking info.

tools.name: listExtensions
tools.description: Installed and available extensions.

tools.name: getVersion
tools.description: Postgres server version details.
